Search Layouts: The difference between List, Grid and Map View

Modified on: Tue, 4 Jun, 2024 at 11:20 AM

Member search results can start in List View, Grid View (requires the Grid View add-on) or Map View (requires the Google Map Search Results add-on).

Navigate to Settings >> Design Settings >> General >> Search Results Pages.

The Member Search Layout setting offers Starts in List View, Starts in Grid View and Starts in Map View Add-on. The Post Search Layout setting offers only List and Grid.
